items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: Yes, he was in the band, but not when I was in there.

ctx.x: Yes, he was in the band, but not when I was in there. But he -- Lucky Millinder had the ability to pick musicians, and he tried to get all of the good musicians in his band with him. And he was a good guy to work for, and he was very, very congenial and very flattering to musicians. But I didn't stay with him too long because he wasn't a jazz player, and you know the band wasn't really my particular style, you know. But I stayed with the band --
Yeah. But it helped you through that
